verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights and suggestions are a fair axis for a feature-management and experimentation SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents one. The AI items describe tooling for managing customers' own AI apps: AI Configs, LLM-as-a-judge evals, and vague 'self-optimizing systems' marketing. The MCP server and CLI expose data to external agents rather than generating insights inside the product. Guarded rollouts and Bayesian experimentation are statistical automation, not described as AI-generated suggestions.
